messages:
vivian (product): Quick broadcast: launching the Private/BYO pilot invites today for a small group. Key bits: BYO-Networking preview (opt-in), optional FIPS mode, and an offline installer for air-gapped customers. Not GA yet.

toni (cs): Great. CS needs a one-pager and an approved email template. Also: customers in APAC will need alternate maintenance windows.

vivian (product): We'll include regional schedule options in the template. Posting draft link in confluence after this thread.

sam (security): Security callouts: FIPS mode requires an attestation upload and triggers a cert rotation. Cipher suites tightened. Customers must explicitly opt in. I'll attach the attestation form.

harry (eng-ops): Pilot rollout plan: onboarding batch (10 partners), 1-week canary (2 tenants), then expand if telemetry is clean. Agent update optional; we provide offline installers and a simple upgrade script for on-prem.

toni (cs): Can we get a short command snippet we can paste to customers for enabling BYO and FIPS?

harry (eng-ops): Snippet: 

```bash
# enable BYO networking for tenant
redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set private.byo_networking=true
# enable FIPS (opt-in)
redwoodctl tenancy update --id <TENANT_ID> --set security.fips_mode=enabled
```

sam (security): Note: FIPS enablement will prompt `redwoodctl cert rotate --tenant <TENANT_ID>`; recommend customers coordinate with their cert team.

toni (cs): Also need an FAQ entry: "Will Redwood see my traffic?" "What happens if agent loses connectivity?"

vivian (product): Short answers for FAQ: BYO keeps ingress/egress on customer network by default. If agent loses connectivity and customer opted into fallback, traffic can be routed to hosted endpoints; otherwise calls fail locally. We'll make that explicit in the template.

harry (eng-ops): Minimal on-prem upgrade runbook for support: 

1) Upload offline installer to host
2) sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent
3) sudo dpkg -i redwood-agent-2.5.x.deb && sudo systemctl start redwood-agent
4) redwood-agent status --health

If healthchecks fail, rollback with the previous installer.

ops-bot: Pilot invite job queued: pilot-byo-2026-10. Reminder scheduled in 72h.

toni (cs): I'll prep the customer-facing email and the pilot acknowledgement form. Please route legal/terms to me if needed.

sam (security): Legal: customers enabling BYO must confirm key custody responsibilities; we'll provide suggested language.

vivian (product): Thanks everyone. Target: invites today, onboarding next week, collect acknowledgements within 7 days. Post final confluence link here when ready.
